ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ صٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
en: (1) Ṣād.[1316] By the Qur’ān containing reminder...[1317]
enNotes:
[1316]- See footnote to 2:1.
[1317]- The completion of the oath is understood to be that the Qur’ān is inimitable and thus a miracle from Allāh.
tr: Ṣād, wal-qurʾāni dhidh-dhikr

ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
en: (2) But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
tr: Balil-ladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatiw washiqāq

ar: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
en: (3) How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
tr: Kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣ

ar: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
en: (4) And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
tr: Waʿajibū an jāʾahum mundhirum minhum, waqālal-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhdhāb

ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
en: (5) Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
tr: Ajaʿalal-ālihata ilāhaw wāḥidā, inna hādhā lashayʾun ʿujāb

ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
en: (6) And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.[1318]
enNotes: [1318]- Planned by Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) in order to gain influence and prestige for himself.
tr: Wanṭalaqal-malaʾu minhum animshū waṣbirū ʿalā ālihatikum, inna hādhā lashayʾuy yurād

ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
en: (7) We have not heard of this in the latest religion.[1319] This is not but a fabrication.
enNotes: [1319]- Referring to Christianity or possibly the pagan religion of the Quraysh.
tr: Mā samiʿnā bihādhā fil-millatil-ākhirah, in hādhā illakhtilāq

ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
en: (8) Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
tr: Aʾunzila ʿalayhidh-dhikru mim bayninā, bal hum fī shakkim min dhikrī, bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhāb

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
en: (9) Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?[1320]
tr: Am ʿindahum khazāʾinu raḥmati rabbikal-ʿazīzil-wahhāb

ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
en: (10) Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.[1321]
enNotes: [1321]- To oversee the affairs of their dominion.
tr: Am lahum mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā, falyartaqū fil-asbāb

ar: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
en: (11) [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
tr: Jundum mā hunālika mahzūmum minal-aḥzāb

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
en: (12) The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,[1322]
tr: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw waʿāduw wafirʿawnu dhul-awtād

ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
en: (13) And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.[1323]
enNotes: [1323]- That were defeated, among whom will be the disbelievers of Quraysh and others.
tr: Wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭiw waʾaṣḥābu lʾaykah, ulāʾikal-aḥzāb

ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
en: (14) Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
tr: In kullun illā kadhdhabar-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqāb

ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
en: (15) And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.[1324]
enNotes: [1324]- Or "respite." More literally, "a period between two milkings of a she-camel," which also alludes to the meanings of "return" or "repetition."
tr: Wamā yanẓuru hāʾulāʾi illā ṣayḥataw wāḥidatam mā lahā min fawāq

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
en: (16) And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
tr: Waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmil-ḥisāb

ar: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
en: (17) Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
tr: Iṣbir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wadhkur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhal-ayd, innahū awwāb

ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
en: (18) Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
tr: Innā sakhkharnal-jibāla maʿahū yusabbiḥna bil-ʿashiyyi wal-ishrāq

ar: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
en: (19) And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
tr: Waṭ-ṭayra maḥshūrah, kullul lahū awwāb

ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
en: (20) And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
tr: Washadadnā mulkahū waʾātaynāhul-ḥikmata wafaṣlal-khiṭāb

ar: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
en: (21) And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
tr: Wahal atāka nabaʾul-khaṣm, idh tasawwarul-miḥrāb

ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
en: (22) When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
tr: Idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa minhum qālū lā takhaf, khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin faḥkum baynanā bil-ḥaqqi walā tushṭiṭ wahdinā ilā sawāʾiṣ-ṣirāṭ

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
en: (23) Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
tr: Inna hādhā akhī, lahū tisʿuw watisʿūna naʿjataw waliya naʿjatuw wāḥidah, faqāla akfilnīhā waʿazzanī fil-khiṭāb

ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
en: (24) [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord[1325] and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
enNotes: [1325]- For his errors, such as fear and suspicion of the two men at the outset, any mistake in judgement he might have made, concealed feelings of partiality, etc.
tr: Qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuʾāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājih, waʾinna kathīram minal-khulaṭāʾi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlum mā hum, waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fastaghfara rabbahū wakharra rākiʿaw waʾanāb

ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
en: (25) So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr: Faghafarnā lahū dhālik, waʾinna lahū ʿindanā lazulfā waḥusna maʾāb

ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
en: (26) [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
tr: Yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fil-arḍi faḥkum baynan-nāsi bil-ḥaqqi walā tattabiʿil-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīlillāh, innal-ladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīlillāhi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdum bimā nasū yawmal-ḥisāb

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًا ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (27) And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
tr: Wamā khalaqnas-samāʾa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilā, dhālika ẓannul-ladhīna kafarū fawaylul lilladhīna kafarū minan-nār

ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
en: (28) Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
tr: Am najʿalul-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti kal-mufsidīna fil-arḍ, am najʿalul-muttaqīna kal-fujjār

ar: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
en: (29) [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
tr: Kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakul liyaddabbarū āyātihī waliyatadhakkara ulul-albāb

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
en: (30) And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
tr: Wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymān, niʿmal-ʿabd, innahū awwāb

ar: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
en: (31) [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
tr: Idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyyiṣ-ṣāfinātul-jiyād

ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
en: (32) And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
tr: Faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubbal-khayri ʿan dhikri rabbī, ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb

ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
en: (33) [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking[1326] [their] legs and necks.
enNotes: [1326]- With his sword as expiation. Some commentaries have also suggested the meaning of "stroking" with the hand.
tr: Ruddūhā ʿalayy, faṭafiqa masḥam bis-sūqi wal-aʿnāq

ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
en: (34) And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body;[1327] then he returned.[1328]
enNotes:
[1327]- Said to be a devil or a lifeless body (one without capability), but Allāh alone knows.
[1328]- To sovereignty and to Allāh in repentance.
tr: Walaqad fatannā sulaymāna waʾalqaynā ʿalā kursiyyihī jasadan thumma anāb

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
en: (35) He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
tr: Qāla rabbighfir lī wahab lī mulkal lā yambaghī liʾaḥadim mim baʿdī, innaka antal-wahhāb

ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
en: (36) So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
tr: Fasakhkharnā lahur-rīḥa tajrī biʾamrihī rukhāʾan ḥaythu aṣāb

ar: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
en: (37) And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
tr: Wash-shayāṭīna kulla bannāʾiw waghawwāṣ

ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
en: (38) And others bound together in irons.
tr: Waʾākharīna muqarranīna fil-aṣfād

ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
en: (39) [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
tr: Hādhā ʿaṭāʾunā famnun aw amsik bighayri ḥisāb

ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
en: (40) And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr: Waʾinna lahū ʿindanā lazulfā waḥusna maʾāb

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
en: (41) And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
tr: Wadhkur ʿabdanā ayyūb, idh nādā rabbahū annī massaniyash-shayṭānu binuṣbiw waʿadhāb

ar: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
en: (42) [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
tr: Urkuḍ birijlik, hādhā mughtasalum bāriduw washarāb

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
en: (43) And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
tr: Wawahabnā lahū ahlahū wamithlahum maʿahum raḥmatam minnā wadhikrā liʾulil-albāb

ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
en: (44) [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."[1329] Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
enNotes: [1329]- At a point during his illness, Job became angry with his wife and swore that if he recovered, he would punish her with one hundred lashes. According to Allāh's instruction, the oath was fulfilled by striking her once with one hundred blades of grass.
tr: Wakhudh biyadika ḍighthan faḍrib bihī walā taḥnath, innā wajadnāhu ṣābirā, niʿmal-ʿabd, innahū awwāb

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
en: (45) And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
tr: Wadhkur ʿibādanā ibrāhīma waʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulil-aydī wal-abṣār

ar: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
en: (46) Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
tr: Innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhikrad-dār

ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
en: (47) And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
tr: Waʾinnahum ʿindanā laminal-muṣṭafaynal-akhyār

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
en: (48) And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
tr: Wadhkur ismāʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhal-kifl, wakullum minal-akhyār

ar: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
en: (49) This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
tr: Hādhā dhikr, waʾinna lil-muttaqīna laḥusna maʾāb

ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
en: (50) Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
tr: Jannāti ʿadnim mufattaḥatal lahumul-abwāb

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
en: (51) Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
tr: Muttakiʾīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratiw washarāb

ar: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
en: (52) And with them will be women limiting [their] glances[1330] and of equal age.
tr: Waʿindahum qāṣirātuṭ-ṭarfi atrāb

ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
en: (53) This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
tr: Hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmil-ḥisāb

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
en: (54) Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
tr: Inna hādhā larizqunā mā lahū min nafād

ar: هَٰذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
en: (55) This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
tr: Hādhā, waʾinna liṭ-ṭāghīna lasharra maʾāb

ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
en: (56) Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
tr: Jahannam, yaṣlawnahā, fabiʾsal-mihād

ar: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
en: (57) This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
tr: Hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmuw waghassāq

ar: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
en: (58) And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
tr: Waʾākharu min shaklihī azwāj

ar: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (59) [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
tr: Hādhā fawjum muqtaḥimum maʿakum, lā marḥabam bihim, innahum ṣālun-nār

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
en: (60) They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
tr: Qālū bal antum lā marḥabam bikum, antum qaddamtumūhu lanā, fabiʾsal-qarār

ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
en: (61) They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
tr: Qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazidhu ʿadhāban ḍiʿfan fin-nār

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
en: (62) And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?[1331]
enNotes: [1331]- They are referring to the believers.
tr: Waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum minal-ashrār

ar: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
en: (63) Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
tr: Attakhadhnāhum sikhriyyan am zāghat ʿanhumul-abṣār

ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (64) Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
tr: Inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahlin-nār

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
en: (65) Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,[1332]
tr: Qul innamā ana mundhir, wamā min ilāhin illallāhul-wāḥidul-qahhār

ar: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
en: (66) Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,[1333] the Perpetual Forgiver."[1334]
enNotes:
[1333]- Honored for absolute power associated with wisdom and justice.
[1334]- Who continually conceals sins and faults.
tr: Rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumal-ʿazīzul-ghaffār

ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
en: (67) Say, "It is great news
tr: Qul huwa nabaʾun ʿaẓīm

ar: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
en: (68) From which you turn away.
tr: Antum ʿanhu muʿriḍūn

ar: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
en: (69) I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
tr: Mā kāna liya min ʿilmim bil-malaʾil-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūn

ar: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (70) It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
tr: Iy yūḥā ilayya illā annamā ana nadhīrum mubīn

ar: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
en: (71) [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
tr: Idh qāla rabbuka lil-malāʾikati innī khāliqum basharam min ṭīn

ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
en: (72) So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[1335] then fall down to him in prostration."
tr: Faʾidhā sawwaytuhū wanafakhtu fīhi mir rūḥī faqaʿū lahū sājidīn

ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
en: (73) So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
tr: Fasajadal-malāʾikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn

ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (74) Except Iblees;[1336] he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
tr: Illā iblīs, istakbara wakāna minal-kāfirīn

ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
en: (75) [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?[1337] Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
tr: Qāla yā iblīsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayy, astakbarta am kunta minal-ʿālīn

ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
en: (76) He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
tr: Qāla ana khayrum minhu khalaqtanī min nāriw wakhalaqtahū min ṭīn

ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
en: (77) [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
tr: Qāla fakhruj minhā faʾinnaka rajīm

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
en: (78) And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
tr: Waʾinna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmid-dīn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: (79) He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
tr: Qāla rabbi faʾanẓirnī ilā yawmi yubʿathūn

ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
en: (80) [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr: Qāla faʾinnaka minal-munẓarīn

ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
en: (81) Until the Day of the time well-known."
tr: Ilā yawmil-waqtil-maʿlūm

ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (82) [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all
tr: Qāla fabiʿizzatika laʾughwiyannahum ajmaʿīn

ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
en: (83) Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
tr: Illā ʿibādaka minhumul-mukhlaṣīn

ar: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
en: (84) [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
tr: Qāla fal-ḥaqq, wal-ḥaqqa aqūl

ar: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (85) [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
tr: Laʾamlaʾanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka minhum ajmaʿīn

ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
en: (86) Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
tr: Qul mā asʾalukum ʿalayhi min ajriw wamā ana minal-mutakallifīn

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (87) It is but a reminder to the worlds.
tr: In huwa illā dhikrul lil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
en: (88) And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
tr: Walataʿlamunna nabaʾahū baʿda ḥīn
